question: Who was appointed as India’s 28th Controller General of Accounts (CGA) in March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SS Dubey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Controller General of Accounts (CGA):

 
 
• Bharati Das, a 1988-batch Indian Civil Accounts Service Officer, took charge as the new Controller General of Accounts in New Delhi on 18 October 2022.
 
• She is the 27th Controller General of Accounts, Ministry of Finance.
 
• CGA is responsible for establishing and maintaining a technically sound Management Accounting System.
 
• The CGA is not a constitutional body. 
 
• The CGA is the Principal Accounting Adviser to the Government of India.
 
• It is also in charge of the exchequer control and internal audits.​
